name: Fetch RTL dependencies
raw_script: git submodule update --init third_party/verilog-axis protocol-processor gptp-processor
canonical: git submodule update --init third_party/verilog-axis protocol-processor gptp-processor

name: Record the tree this worker validates
raw_script:
set -euo pipefail
head="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
if [ "$head" != "$GITHUB_SHA" ] || [ "$GITHUB_SHA" != "$TARGET_SHA" ]; then
  echo "checkout $head, GITHUB_SHA $GITHUB_SHA and gate target $TARGET_SHA must be one SHA" >&2
  exit 1
fi
mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/suite-logs"
printf '%s\n' "$GITHUB_SHA" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/suite-logs/TARGET_SHA"
echo "target_sha=$GITHUB_SHA"
canonical: echo "checkout $head, GITHUB_SHA $GITHUB_SHA and gate target $TARGET_SHA must be one SHA" >&2

name: Build Verilator from source on cache miss
raw_script:
set -euo pipefail
sudo apt-get update -qq
sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
  git make autoconf g++ flex bison libfl2 libfl-dev help2man perl python3
git clone --depth 1 --branch "$VERILATOR_VERSION" \
  https://github.com/verilator/verilator.git /tmp/verilator-src
cd /tmp/verilator-src
autoconf
./configure --prefix=/opt/verilator
make -j"$(nproc)"
sudo make install
canonical: sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends git make autoconf g++ flex bison libfl2 libfl-dev help2man perl python3

name: Put Verilator on PATH and prove the version
raw_script:
echo "/opt/verilator/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
/opt/verilator/bin/verilator --version
/opt/verilator/bin/verilator --version | grep -F "${VERILATOR_VERSION#v}"

name: Prove specialized suite ownership
raw_script:
set -euo pipefail
python3 scripts/suite_shards.py --selftest
scripts/run_all_suites.sh --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --list \
  > "$RUNNER_TEMP/owned-suites"
echo "Shard $SHARD owns:"
sed 's/^/  /' "$RUNNER_TEMP/owned-suites"
case "$SHARD" in
  1) grep -Fx tsn_fuzz "$RUNNER_TEMP/owned-suites" ;;
  3) grep -Fx chmap_capture "$RUNNER_TEMP/owned-suites" ;;
  4) test "$(cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/owned-suites")" = milan_dp ;;
esac

name: Build Yosys from source on cache miss
raw_script:
set -euo pipefail
sudo apt-get update -qq
sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
  git make g++ bison flex libfl-dev pkg-config zlib1g-dev python3
git clone --depth 1 --branch "$YOSYS_VERSION" \
  https://github.com/YosysHQ/yosys.git /tmp/yosys-src
git -C /tmp/yosys-src submodule update --init --depth 1 abc libs/cxxopts
make -C /tmp/yosys-src config-gcc
printf 'ENABLE_TCL := 0\nENABLE_READLINE := 0\nENABLE_PLUGINS := 0\n' \
  >> /tmp/yosys-src/Makefile.conf
make -C /tmp/yosys-src -j"$(nproc)" PREFIX=/opt/yosys
sudo make -C /tmp/yosys-src install PREFIX=/opt/yosys
git -C /tmp/yosys-src/abc rev-parse HEAD | sudo tee /opt/yosys/ABC_REV
# runner-owned so the cache action's save and restore are symmetric
sudo chown -R "$(id -u):$(id -g)" /opt/yosys
canonical: sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends git make g++ bison flex libfl-dev pkg-config zlib1g-dev python3
# runner-owned so the cache action's save and restore are symmetric

name: Install the pinned Yosys and prove the version
raw_script:
set -euo pipefail
sudo apt-get update -qq
sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends libjemalloc2
sudo ln -sf /opt/yosys/bin/yosys /opt/yosys/bin/yosys-abc /usr/local/bin/
test -x /opt/yosys/bin/yosys-abc
echo "bundled ABC: $(cat /opt/yosys/ABC_REV)"
yosys -V
yosys -V | grep -F "Yosys ${YOSYS_VERSION#v}"

name: Install sv2v for the netlist-level suite owner
raw_script:
set -euo pipefail
ver=v0.0.12
sha256=ff8c9eea5bc029b372fb4953427625cddb7cf7e58c1240623ac9f260818d5a00
url="https://github.com/zachjs/sv2v/releases/download/${ver}/sv2v-Linux.zip"
curl -fsSL "$url" -o /tmp/sv2v.zip
echo "${sha256}  /tmp/sv2v.zip" | sha256sum -c -
unzip -q -o /tmp/sv2v.zip -d /tmp/sv2v
sudo install -m755 "$(find /tmp/sv2v -name sv2v -type f | head -1)" \
  /usr/local/bin/sv2v
sv2v --version

name: Build the pinned tsn-gen field oracle on its suite owner
raw_script:
set -euo pipefail
git clone --filter=blob:none \
  https://github.com/kebag-logic/tsn-gen.git "$RUNNER_TEMP/tsn-gen"
git -C "$RUNNER_TEMP/tsn-gen" checkout "$TSN_GEN_REV"
git -C "$RUNNER_TEMP/tsn-gen" submodule update \
  --init --depth 1 --recursive external/rapidyaml
cmake -S "$RUNNER_TEMP/tsn-gen" -B "$RUNNER_TEMP/tsn-gen/build" \
  -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DENABLE_PARSER_TESTS=OFF
cmake --build "$RUNNER_TEMP/tsn-gen/build" \
  --target packet_gen --parallel
test -x "$RUNNER_TEMP/tsn-gen/build/traffic-gen/packet_gen"
echo "TSN_GEN_ROOT=$RUNNER_TEMP/tsn-gen" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

name: Run this exhaustive suite shard
raw_script:
scripts/run_all_suites.sh "$RUNNER_TEMP/suite-logs" \
  --shard "${{ matrix.shard }}/${{ matrix.total }}"

name: Require every shard to have validated this run's SHA
raw_script:
shopt -s nullglob
roots=("$RUNNER_TEMP"/all-suite-logs/suite-logs-*)
python3 scripts/ci_events.py --require-target-sha --expect 5 \
  --sha gate="$GATE_SHA" --sha run="$GITHUB_SHA" \
  --sha checkout="$(git rev-parse HEAD)" -- "${roots[@]}"
canonical: python3 scripts/ci_events.py --require-target-sha --expect 5 --sha gate="$GATE_SHA" --sha run="$GITHUB_SHA" --sha checkout="$(git rev-parse HEAD)" -- "${roots[@]}"

name: Prove exhaustive ownership and tally every log
raw_script:
shopt -s nullglob
roots=("$RUNNER_TEMP"/all-suite-logs/suite-logs-*)
if [ "${#roots[@]}" -eq 0 ]; then
  mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/all-suite-logs/none"
  roots=("$RUNNER_TEMP/all-suite-logs/none")
fi
python3 scripts/suite_tally.py "${roots[@]}" --quiet \
  --expect-suite-root tb/verilator

name: Require every Verilator worker to pass
raw_script:
if [ "$SHARD_RESULT" != success ]; then
  echo "one or more Verilator workers ended: $SHARD_RESULT" >&2
  exit 1
fi
echo "verilator-suites: every worker succeeded at $GITHUB_SHA"
canonical: echo "one or more Verilator workers ended: $SHARD_RESULT" >&2

  sudo apt-get update -qq

}
python3 syn/ooc/dp_srcs.py --selftest
python3 syn/ooc/ooc_tcl_selftest.py

name: Print the event and pin the one SHA this run validates
raw_script:
set -euo pipefail
echo "event=$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME ref=$GITHUB_REF sha=$GITHUB_SHA"
head="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
if [ "$head" != "$GITHUB_SHA" ]; then
  echo "checkout HEAD $head is not GITHUB_SHA $GITHUB_SHA" >&2
  exit 1
fi
echo "target_sha=$GITHUB_SHA" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
